facts.text: It had a high-pressure methane atmosphere that was unpleasant or deadly to offworlders.

evidence.quote: It had a high-pressure methane atmosphere that was unpleasant or deadly to offworlders.

facts.text: For many millennia it remained disconnected from the Galactic Republic due to the Skakoans' xenophobic and isolationist tendencies, but eventually the Skakoan Foreman Wat Tambor of the Techno Union became de facto representative of the world and its people in the Galactic Senate.

evidence.quote: For many millennia it remained disconnected from the Galactic Republic due to the Skakoans' xenophobic and isolationist tendencies, but eventually the Skakoan Foreman Wat Tambor of the Techno Union became de facto representative of the world and its people in the Galactic Senate.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the world indirectly supported the Confederacy of Independent Systems, due to Tambor's allegiance with them.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the world indirectly supported the Confederacy of Independent Systems, due to Tambor's allegiance with them.

facts.text: As a consequence, it was captured by the Republic.

evidence.quote: As a consequence, it was captured by the Republic.

facts.text: Following the end of the war, the Galactic Empire placed emigration restrictions on Skako and caused its people to suffer greatly, although many Skakoans were happy to remain isolated from the galaxy on Skako.

evidence.quote: Following the end of the war, the Galactic Empire placed emigration restrictions on Skako and caused its people to suffer greatly, although many Skakoans were happy to remain isolated from the galaxy on Skako.

facts.text: The world had a high-pressure methane atmosphere that to offwordlers was uncomfortable at best and deadly at worst, with even non-native methane breathers finding the pressure unpleasant.

evidence.quote: The world had a high-pressure methane atmosphere that to offwordlers was uncomfortable at best and deadly at worst, with even non-native methane breathers finding the pressure unpleasant.

facts.text: Rich in metallic resources, Skako was developed into an ecumenopolis by the technology focused Skakoan species native to the world.

evidence.quote: Rich in metallic resources, Skako was developed into an ecumenopolis by the technology focused Skakoan species native to the world.

facts.text: The planet's dense upper atmosphere consisted of an alkaline haze due to solar strikes.

evidence.quote: The planet's dense upper atmosphere consisted of an alkaline haze due to solar strikes.

facts.text: Skako was first mentioned in the new Star Wars canon in a featurette included in Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One, a box set available on Blu-ray or DVD that included the entire first season of the canon animated series Star Wars: The Clone Wars that was released on November 3, 2...
entities: Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One
Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One

evidence.quote: Skako was first mentioned in the new Star Wars canon in a featurette included in Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One, a box set available on Blu-ray or DVD that included the entire first season of the canon animated series Star Wars: The Clone Wars that was released on November 3, 2009

facts.text: The world was then pictured for the first time in Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game, a roleplaying game released by Fantasy Flight Games in 2015.
entities: Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game

evidence.quote: The world was then pictured for the first time in Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game, a roleplaying game released by Fantasy Flight Games in 2015.

facts.text: The world originated in the Star Wars Legends continuity, where it was created for Cloak of Deception, a 2001 novel written by James Luceno.

evidence.quote: The world originated in the Star Wars Legends continuity, where it was created for Cloak of Deception, a 2001 novel written by James Luceno.

facts.text: The similarly named world of Skako Minor was introduced to canon by the "Bad Batch" arc of the Star Wars: The Clone Wars television series, which was originally released as unfinished production reels in 2015.

evidence.quote: The similarly named world of Skako Minor was introduced to canon by the "Bad Batch" arc of the Star Wars: The Clone Wars television series, which was originally released as unfinished production reels in 2015.

facts.text: During the episodes set on Skako Minor, characters refer to the world as just "Skako" several times, and Anakin Skywalker referred to Skako Minor as "Skako" in the 2019 book Choose Your Destiny: An Obi-Wan & Anakin Adventure.
entities: Choose Your Destiny: An Obi-Wan & Anakin Adventure

evidence.quote: During the episodes set on Skako Minor, characters refer to the world as just "Skako" several times, and Anakin Skywalker referred to Skako Minor as "Skako" in the 2019 book Choose Your Destiny: An Obi-Wan & Anakin Adventure.

facts.text: However, the 2018 role-playing supplement Fully Operational clarified that Skako and Skako Minor were separate worlds.

evidence.quote: However, the 2018 role-playing supplement Fully Operational clarified that Skako and Skako Minor were separate worlds.

facts.text: A trivia gallery caption in the episode guide for the episode "A Distant Echo" also erroneously describes Skako Minor as "home" of the Skakoan people, rather than Skako.

evidence.quote: A trivia gallery caption in the episode guide for the episode "A Distant Echo" also erroneously describes Skako Minor as "home" of the Skakoan people, rather than Skako.

facts.text: The Skakoans rarely left the world due to their dependence on the methane-based atmosphere and heavy atmospheric pressures.

evidence.quote: The Skakoans rarely left the world due to their dependence on the methane-based atmosphere and heavy atmospheric pressures.

facts.text: Establishing a major ecumenopolis comparable in terms of population and scale to Coruscant, the planet-wide city lacked the Republic capital's charm and aesthetics.

evidence.quote: Establishing a major ecumenopolis comparable in terms of population and scale to Coruscant, the planet-wide city lacked the Republic capital's charm and aesthetics.

facts.text: In addition to the Skakoan people, the planet was also home to the octuptarras— an eight-eyed creature with a gasbag-shaped head and multiple legs which inhabited the planet's vines.

evidence.quote: In addition to the Skakoan people, the planet was also home to the octuptarras— an eight-eyed creature with a gasbag-shaped head and multiple legs which inhabited the planet's vines.

facts.text: The harsh environment on the planet ensured that the world was rarely visited and left in isolation, much to the contentment of the natives.

evidence.quote: The harsh environment on the planet ensured that the world was rarely visited and left in isolation, much to the contentment of the natives.

facts.text: Skako was discovered during the blazing of the Brentaal–Denon Route of the Hydian Way, before the formation of the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Skako was discovered during the blazing of the Brentaal–Denon Route of the Hydian Way, before the formation of the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: Attaining membership in the Galactic Republic Senate, the Skakoans also had a leading interest within the Techno Union by the time of the Separatist Crisis which plagued the Republic in its final days.

evidence.quote: Attaining membership in the Galactic Republic Senate, the Skakoans also had a leading interest within the Techno Union by the time of the Separatist Crisis which plagued the Republic in its final days.

facts.text: The Skakoan representative Wat Tambor led the Techno Union away from the Republic and to the Confederacy of Independent Systems, for which Skako was expelled from the Republic.

evidence.quote: The Skakoan representative Wat Tambor led the Techno Union away from the Republic and to the Confederacy of Independent Systems, for which Skako was expelled from the Republic.

facts.text: When the Clone Wars erupted, Skako was a member world of the CIS, but was placed under the watchful eye of the 1st Sector Army of the Grand Army of the Republic.

evidence.quote: When the Clone Wars erupted, Skako was a member world of the CIS, but was placed under the watchful eye of the 1st Sector Army of the Grand Army of the Republic.

facts.text: After Skako fell to the Republic and Foreman Tambor was murdered on Mustafar with the rest of the Separatist Council, the Confederacy collapsed and the Galactic Empire replaced the Republic.

evidence.quote: After Skako fell to the Republic and Foreman Tambor was murdered on Mustafar with the rest of the Separatist Council, the Confederacy collapsed and the Galactic Empire replaced the Republic.

facts.text: Heralding a new era of Human High Culture, the Empire crushed the Techno Union and persecuted the Skakoans for their involvement in the war.

evidence.quote: Heralding a new era of Human High Culture, the Empire crushed the Techno Union and persecuted the Skakoans for their involvement in the war.

facts.text: Retreating to Skako to resume their isolationist stance, the Skakoans avoided the destruction of the Yuuzhan Vong War by remaining distant from both the New Republic and the Galactic Alliance.

evidence.quote: Retreating to Skako to resume their isolationist stance, the Skakoans avoided the destruction of the Yuuzhan Vong War by remaining distant from both the New Republic and the Galactic Alliance.

facts.text: By 130 ABY, Skako had been enveloped by the Empire of Darth Krayt.

evidence.quote: By 130 ABY, Skako had been enveloped by the Empire of Darth Krayt.
